acts.title: The Alpine Castle
acts.description: Arriving by classic Rolls-Royce at the iconic neo-Gothic fairy-tale palace in St. Moritz.
acts.fact: 💡 HIGHLIGHT: 1896 ICONIC ALPINE PALACE ON LAKE ST. MORITZ

acts.title: Snow-Covered Pine Promenade
acts.description: Strolling through fresh alpine powder past frosted pine trees along the tranquil frozen lake.

acts.title: Le Grand Hall Splendor
acts.description: Sipping tea beneath monumental coffered wood ceilings and historic European oil paintings.

acts.title: Granite Alpine Pool
acts.description: Swimming through floor-to-ceiling glass pavilions facing the snow-capped Engadin summits.
acts.fact: 💡 EXPERIENCE: HEATED GLASS-WALLED POOL OVERLOOKING LAKE

acts.title: Palace Wellness Thermal Spa
acts.description: Steaming outdoor whirlpool baths surrounded by mountain snow and aromatic Swiss pine saunas.
acts.fact: 💡 WELLNESS: OUTDOOR HEATED HYDROTHERAPY & CEDAR SAUNAS

acts.title: Alpine Alpenglow Champagne
acts.description: Vintage champagne toast as the dramatic sunset Alpenglow illuminates the Swiss alpine peaks.
acts.fact: 💡 SUNSET: GOLDEN ALPENGLOW OVER THE ENGADIN SUMMITS
